title: The Fifth Trumpet: The Locusts, The Sixth Trumpet: The Angels from the Euphrates

questions.question: And the fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star fallen from heaven to earth, and he was given the key to the shaft of the ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:1 (ESV): "And the fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star fallen from heaven to earth, and he was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit."

questions.question: He opened the shaft of the bottomless pit, and from the shaft rose ____ like the ____ of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened...
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:2 (ESV): "He opened the shaft of the bottomless pit, and from the shaft rose smoke like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened with the smoke from the shaft."

questions.question: Then from the smoke came ____ on the earth, and they were given power like the power of ____ of the earth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:3 (ESV): "Then from the smoke came locusts on the earth, and they were given power like the power of scorpions of the earth."

questions.question: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any green plant or any tree, but only those people who do not have the seal of ____ on their foreheads.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:4 (ESV): "They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any green plant or any tree, but only those people who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads."

questions.question: They were allowed to torment them for ____ months, but not to kill them, and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it stings someone.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:5 (ESV): "They were allowed to torment them for five months, but not to kill them, and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it stings someone."

questions.question: And in those days people will seek ____ and will not find it. They will long to die, but ____ will flee from them.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:6 (ESV): "And in those days people will seek death and will not find it. They will long to die, but death will flee from them."

questions.question: In appearance the locusts were like horses prepared for battle... on their heads were what looked like crowns of gold; their faces were like ____ faces,
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:7 (ESV): "In appearance the locusts were like horses prepared for battle: on their heads were what looked like crowns of gold; their faces were like human faces,"

questions.question: They have as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he is called ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:11 (ESV): "They have as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he is called Apollyon."

questions.question: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice... saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river ____."
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:13-14 (ESV): "Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God, saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, 'Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.'"

questions.question: So the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour, the day, the month, and the year, were released to kill a ____ of mankind.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:15 (ESV): "So the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour, the day, the month, and the year, were released to kill a third of mankind."

questions.question: The number of mounted troops was ____; I heard their number.
options: twice ten thousand times ten thousand
questions.correctAnswer: twice ten thousand times ten thousand
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:16 (ESV): "The number of mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand; I heard their number." (This equals 200,000,000)

questions.question: By these three plagues a third of mankind was killed, by the ____ and ____ and ____ coming out of their mouths.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:18 (ESV): "By these three plagues a third of mankind was killed, by the fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths."

questions.question: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails, for their tails are like ____ with heads, and by means of them they wound.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:19 (ESV): "For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails, for their tails are like serpents with heads, and by means of them they wound."

questions.question: The rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not ____ of the works of their hands nor give up worshiping demons and idols...
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:20 (ESV): "The rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands nor give up worshiping demons and idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk,"

questions.question: nor did they repent of their ____ or their ____ or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
questions.explanation: Revelation 9:21 (ESV): "nor did they repent of their murders or their sorceries or their sexual immorality or their thefts."

key_verse_text: The rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands nor give up worshiping demons and idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk,
